topic: Fluid Ancient HP bar with responsive heartbeat
currentUserGoal: Make the Ancient HP bar move fluidly and visibly pump like a heartbeat without compromising the ecosystem prototype's performance.
workCompleted: Moved the HP bar's displayed width from the 200 ms UI refresh cadence to frame-rate-independent per-frame interpolation while leaving deterministic HP simulation untouched.
Added a reusable additive glow layer and a two-beat heartbeat profile that accelerates and becomes more pronounced as Ancient HP falls.
Kept the implementation allocation-free in the scene hot path and avoided particles, timers, and heartbeat tweens.
Integrated the heartbeat layer into desktop and mobile header layouts and preserved the existing healing flash behavior.
Exposed displayed HP ratio and heartbeat pulse in the redesign performance harness for repeatable browser verification.
Added focused tests for monotonic smoothing, frame-rate independence, and low-HP heartbeat acceleration.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 129 Vitest tests across 18 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Desktop browser verification covered healthy, mid-health, and red danger states on the actual ecosystemPrototype route.
Mobile browser verification at 390x844 confirmed the pumping bar remains inside the compact header without overlapping adjacent readouts.
The redesign harness measured average animation work around 0.03-0.05 ms per frame, zero active tweens, zero active effects, and no full-field scans during the test.
Browser console contained no errors or warnings.

release.status: Local ecosystem prototype checkpoint; not pushed, merged into master, or promoted to production.

currentGitStatus: The HP animation implementation, tests, and this handoff are intended for one local commit on codex/ecosystem-factory-prototype.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless the user explicitly requests it.
The local Vite server remains available at http://127.0.0.1:5173.
knownIssues: The heartbeat is intentionally a display-layer signal; it does not alter HP damage, healing, or Scourge timing.
The performance harness snapshots the pulse at the UI refresh cadence, while the visible bar itself animates every rendered frame.
A static screenshot may capture the glow between beats; motion is most apparent during live play, especially below 25 percent HP.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user judge the heartbeat strength and cadence during a real first-run failure.
Tune only the visual amplitude or cadence if requested; keep HP balance changes inside the deterministic ecosystem model.
Continue the visible Field Mouse resource-chain objective after the health presentation is approved.
doNotRevert: Keep the simulated HP value deterministic and separate from displayedHpRatio.
Keep heartbeat work allocation-free and bounded to the two existing rectangle layers.
Do not move HP width updates back into the throttled refreshUi path.
Do not use Phaser heartbeat tweens that would conflict with the existing healing flash or accumulate during long runs.
